raw:
The user wants UI strings for a file management app in Traditional Chinese (繁體中文).

The app: users can create a new "container" (容器) to organize things, and can move an item into it.

Strings needed:
- "s1": button for creating a new container (建立新容器的按鈕)
- "s2": status text after creation (建立後的狀態文字)
- "s3": dialog title for moving an item (移動項目的對話框標題)

Let me think about natural Traditional Chinese UI strings.

"s1" - a button to create a new container. Common patterns: "新增容器" (Add container) or "建立新容器" (Create new container). Buttons are usually concise: "新增容器" is very natural in Taiwan-style UI (Material Design Chinese localization uses "新增" for "Add"/"New"). Alternatively "建立新容器". I'll go with "新增容器".

"s2" - status text after creation. Something like "已建立「{name}」" or "容器已建立". Status text could be a toast/snackbar. Since it's after creation, something like "已建立新容器" or if with a name placeholder "已建立「{0}」". The instruction says value is a string; no mention of placeholders. But could include a placeholder... risky. Keep it simple: "容器已建立" or "已成功建立容器". Common: "已建立容器". I'll use "容器已建立".

Actually, thinking about it more, maybe include the name placeholder? The prompt didn't ask for it, so keep it simple without placeholders to be safe. "容器已建立" is a fine status message.

"s3" - dialog title for moving an item. Common: "移動項目" or "將項目移至..." or "移動「{name}」". Simple: "移動項目" or "選擇目的地" — but the requested is "移動項目的對話框標題" — the title of the dialog for moving an item. "移動項目" is direct. Could be "移動至容器" since the item is moved into a container. Hmm. The dialog allows moving an item into a container, so title could be "移動項目" or "移動至..." Let me think — the context: "把一個項目移進去" (move an item into the container). So the dialog title might be "移動項目" with options listing containers. "移動項目" is a good generic title. Or "將項目移動至容器" — a bit long for a title. I'll use "移動項目".

Output: only a JSON object with keys s1, s2, s3.

```json
{
  "s1": "新增容器",
  "s2": "容器已建立",
  "s3": "移動項目"
}
```

Only output JSON, no other text. Should I use code fence? The instruction says "只輸出一個 JSON 物件...不要其他文字" — a code fence might count as other text. Output raw JSON.{
  "s1": "新增容器",
  "s2": "容器已建立",
  "s3": "移動項目"
}
